title: New Fence Posts

intro.speaker: amos
intro.text: Hello! Mrs. Hannah asked me to come out with my tools. The cows pushed down the old fence.

intro.speaker: amos
intro.text: The posts must be the same distance apart, or the rails won't fit. Use the stick to measure each space.

steps.speaker: amos
steps.prompt: Put a post one stick away from the gatepost. Then one stick away from that post, and so on.
steps.hint: Lay the stick next to the gatepost. Where does the other end reach? Put a post there.

feedback.placed_all: Now let's check with the stick. Does it fit each space?
feedback.crowded: Look: the stick covers a post there. Can that post move further along?
feedback.far: Look: there's a gap past the end of the stick. Can that post move closer?
feedback.all_good: Every space is one stick long. The rails will fit perfectly!

outro.speaker: amos
outro.text: A good fence keeps the cows safe in their meadow. Mrs. Hannah will sleep easy tonight.

journal_line: I helped Mr. Amos put up new fence posts at the farm.
